name: amicode-companion
description: The always-local ui-kind companion to Amicode — a client-side link sensor that survives the main extension relocating to the host under Remote-SSH. Feasibility spike (#1274, ADR 0025 P2). Holds no engine or store.

amicode.companion.hubUrl.description: Client-side base URL the always-local companion probes for hub liveness (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:4096). The companion bundles its own probe and reads ONLY this client-side setting — it never reads the host-side running instance or posture file. Empty = the companion reports the honest no-hub-configured state.

amicode.companion.localWorkspacePath.description: Absolute LOCAL folder the auto-DOWN drop reopens into — the thin-client lifeboat where the host-file mount surfaces your files when the hub link is down. Empty = no local target known; the companion still surfaces the transition and the honest ‘no local folder’ error rather than opening a half-window.

amicode.companion.hubSshAlias.description: Hub Remote-SSH alias the prompt-UP reopen returns into on a sustained link recovery. On recovery the companion PROMPTS to reopen this window in Remote-SSH (vscode-remote://ssh-remote+<alias>/~) and reopens only if you accept — never a forced switch. Empty = no Remote-SSH target known; a recovery then surfaces an honest ‘cannot resolve target’ notice rather than a half-prompt.
